The easiest way to make delicious, restaurant-style dal khichdi at home without the hassle of cooking the dal and rice separately. I’ve shared all the tips to get that rich, comforting restaurant-style flavour using a simple pressure cooker method.
So many of you loved my restaurant-style version and asked for a quicker way to make it, and this one is just what you need! Do give it a try. Happy Cooking!
